name: fyi.makerradar/directory
title: MakerRadar.fyi
description: Query a curated indie product directory: search, details, pricing, editor FAQs, weekly picks.

tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search the MakerRadar directory of curated indie products. Free-text search matches product names and descriptions; combine with a category slug. Returns product cards only — call get_product for full detail.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get one product's full listing by slug: description, audience, use cases, key features, verified pricing plans, editor FAQs, tags, discovery source and related products. Slug comes from search_products or the /products/<slug> URL.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List all active product categories with their published-product counts. Use a returned slug as categorySlug in search_products.

tools.name: list_weekly_issues
tools.description: List published Weekly Picks issues, newest first, with per-issue product counts. Call get_weekly_issue for one issue's products and selection reasons.

tools.name: get_weekly_issue
tools.description: Get one published Weekly Picks issue by slug: the issue's intro and every selected product with the editor's selection reason — why that product made the week's list.
